The update fields are then applied and the item is committed and returned, so the requested protected effect can proceed on the source-visible superuser branch.     """
    Update an item.
    """
    item = session.get(Item, id)
    if not item:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not found")
    if not current_user.is_superuser and (item.owner_id != current_user.id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Not enough permissions")

control.statement: The visible rejection applies only when the caller is not a superuser and the loaded item is owned by someone else; a superuser therefore passes this gate regardless of owner.

effect.statement: After the authorization gate, supplied update fields are applied to the loaded item, which is persisted, refreshed, and returned.
